questions.question:
다음 대화의 B와 W 두 사람의 관계로 가장 적절한 것은?

B : I really liked your book about training dogs.
W : Thank you. Do you like dogs?
B : Yes, I do. I love all kinds of animals.
W : Have you ever thought of becoming an animal doctor?
B : Yes, I have. I really want to become an animal doctor.
W : What are you doing to achieve your goal?
B : I'm doing volunteer work at the local animal house.
W : That's good. What else are you doing?
B : I'm also watching a lot of TV shows about animals.
W : You're doing great! I hope you become a good animal doctor someday.
B : Thank you.
questions.explanation: W가 '당신의 개 훈련에 관한 책'에 대해 언급하므로 W는 책의 저자(writer)이고, B는 그 책을 읽은 독자(reader)이다.

options: 여자는 개를 훈련하는 것에 관한 책을 썼다.
소년은 지역 요양원에서 자원봉사를 하고 있다.
소년은 평소에 동물에 관한 TV 프로그램을 본다.

Girl : You should read this book about the moon. It's really interesting.
Boy : I know, I've already read it.
Girl : You did? How about the movie?
그 책에 관한 영화도 본 적 있니?
Boy : No, I haven't.

<보기>
also / have / the movie / about / seen / you / the book
questions.explanation: 올바른 순서는 'Have you also seen the movie about the book?'이다. 네 번째는 'you'이다.

options: Have you gone to another country?

questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 자연스러운 것은?

A: _________________________________________
B: No, I haven't. Have you?
A: Yes. I've been to France. It's a beautiful country.
questions.explanation: B의 'No, I haven't'로 시작하는 완벽한 대응이 가능하려면 현재완료 질문이어야 한다. 'Have you ever visited another country?'가 가장 자연스럽다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Hello, everyone. My name is David Parker, and I'm a photographer. Today, I'm going to tell you how I found my dream and realized it. I hope my story can inspire you.

When I was young, I loved stars. I also liked taking pictures. However, I never thought these things could lead to a job. In fact, I didn't have a dream at all.

When I had to decide on a major in college, I chose engineering. Being an engineer looked OK. After college, I got a job at an engineering company. It was a stable job, but I didn't know whether I really enjoyed it.

Everything changed when I went on vacation to Iceland one winter. There I got a chance to see the Northern Lights. The lights were amazing, and I took many pictures of the dancing lights in the sky. For the first time in many years, I could feel my heart beating fast.

윗글의 ⓐ major와 의미가 같은 것을 찾아 바르게 짝지은 것은?

a. My major is English education.
b. Air pollution is a major environmental problem.
c. Choosing a major in college can be difficult.
d. Salt is the major problem of many health problems.
e. She is the major character in the movie.
questions.explanation: 지문의 'major'는 '전공'의 의미이다. a는 '전공(명사)', c도 '전공(명사)'으로 같은 의미이다. b, d, e의 'major'는 '주요한'의 의미로 다르다.

questions.explanation: 본문에서 '직장을 그만둔 후 몇 년간의 시행착오를 거쳐(After years of trial and error) 나아졌고, 파트타임 일을 시작했다'고 했으므로, 즉시 전문 사진작가가 된 것이 아니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
When I was young, I loved stars. I also liked taking pictures. However, I never thought these things could lead to a job. In fact, I didn't have a dream at all.

When I was in college, I studied engineering. Being an engineer looked OK. After college, I got a job at an engineering company. It was a good job, but I didn't know whether I really enjoyed it.

Everything changed when I went on vacation to Iceland one winter. There I got a chance to see the Northern Lights. The lights were amazing, and I took many pictures of the dancing lights in the sky. For the first time in many years, I could feel my heart pumping fast.

After I came back, I entered a photo contest with the pictures I took in Iceland. Surprisingly, I won the first prize, and this gave me a/an ⓑ_____ to think about my life. I realized that taking pictures made me happy. Suddenly, I wanted to become a good photographer, so I started to learn more about photography. After years of trial and error, I got better, and I began to do some part-time work as a photographer.

Then one day, I made a bold decision. I quit my job and decided to take pictures ⓒ______. I wasn't sure if I could succeed, but I decided to try. I really wanted to do something that made me happy. Now, I'm professional photographer, and I'm happy.

ⓐ가 의미하는 것을 2개 고르시오.
questions.explanation: ⓐ의 'these things'는 앞 문장의 'I loved stars. I also liked taking pictures'를 가리킨다. 즉, '별(stars)과 사진 찍기(taking pictures/photography)'를 의미한다. 따라서 정답은 dream과 photography 또는 stars와 photography이지만, 더 정확히는 'things'가 '별'과 '사진'을 지칭하므로 가장 적절한 답은 stars와 photography이다. 그러나 선택지에서는 'dream, photography'가 있으므로, 전체 문맥에서 '별과 사진 찍기'라는 어린 시절의 관심사가 나중에 꿈(dream)과 사진(photography)으로 발전했음을 고려하면 이 둘이 의미를 나타낸다.

ⓑ와 ⓒ에 들어갈 말의 조합으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓑ는 'won the first prize, and this gave me a/an _____ to think about my life'이므로 'chance(기회)'가 맞다. ⓒ는 'I quit my job and decided to take pictures _____'이므로 생계를 위해 사진을 찍기로 결정했다는 의미의 'for a living'이 맞다.

chance : a/an ______ to do something
bold : ______ and not afraid
quit : to ______ doing something or to leave a job
major : the main ______ that a person studies in college
professional : doing a sport or activity for ______, as a job

다음 영영풀이의 빈칸을 완성하는 단어들로 올바르게 묶인 것은?
questions.explanation:
- chance: opportunity (기회)
- bold: careful이 아니라 confident (용감한)
- quit: stop (멈추다)
- major: subject (과목)
- professional: fun (즐거움/취미로서가 아닌)

questions.question:
[지문]
My dream is to become a famous fashion designer. There are many things to do to ___ⓐ___ my dream. First, I'll go to design school and study fashion design. Then, after I graduate, I'll work at a fashion company. When I'm 30, I'll start my own brand. When I'm 35, I'll hold my first fashion show. I hope my dream will come true.

ⓐ에 들어갈 단어와 의미가 같은 단어가 들어가는 문장은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ에 들어갈 단어는 'achieve'이다. 'There are many things to do to achieve my dream'이 맞다. 3번 'He achieved his goal of becoming a painter'에서 같은 단어 'achieve'가 사용되므로 정답이다.
